title: Build Executor Measurement Record
description: One declared executor-model experiment cell and its observed measurement, emitted by the xtask build_measurement harness (#11639, child of controller #9547). Fail-closed: every fact the harness could not actually observe reports null / an explicit unavailable-unobserved state, never zero or a borrowed value. Raw observed facts (command, environment, timings, admissions) and the normalized interpretation carry separate sha256 digests so the #11642 decision successor can challenge the interpretation without trusting the harness's model labels.

protocol_version.description: Records under different protocol versions are never matched pairs.

cell.description: The declared experiment cell: workflow_class, execution_model, operation, subject identity, host profile, repetition ordinal, declared growth paths with their filesystems, lock policy, and capacity policy. Includes the canonical content digest (cell identity) is carried inside the harness's canonical_id computation and the normalized_digest.

command.description: The literal structured invocation: program, args, and the effective environment it ran under.

environment.description: Toolchain/host identity: cargo_version, rustc_version, host_triple. Unprobeable fields are null.

timings.description: Monotonic phase decomposition: preparation_nanos, admission_wait_nanos (queue/lock wait is work and stays inside the total), execution_nanos, reporting_nanos, total_wall_nanos, tolerance_nanos. Null phases mean the record is incomplete and NOT_PROVEN.

disk_admission.description: Free-space measurements on the actual growth filesystems plus declared-vs-actual filesystem mismatches. Null means no admission was recorded.

lock.description: Observed lock state: held (with the whole-cargo-process primitive spelled out, never renamed into a compile lock), policy_declares_none (honest unlocked run), primitive_unavailable, or unobserved. The latter two are NOT_PROVEN, never a locked success.

process.description: Observed process tree (descendant_count, terminality) or instrument_unavailable. An unavailable instrument is NOT_PROVEN, never zero descendants.

cache.description: Cache observation under an exact server/process identity: baseline and delta counter snapshots, foreign_users_observed between snapshots, and the attribution verdict. Environment variables such as SCCACHE_BASEDIRS never constitute reuse evidence.

work.description: Selected/executed work: expected_selected, observed_selected, exit_code. Proof cells require observed selected work matching the expected count and exceeding zero.

executed_subject.description: The subject the cell actually executed, as proven by artifact/output identity metadata. Null means the executed subject stays unproven; it is never assumed equal to the declared subject.

raw_digest.description: sha256-prefixed digest over the raw observed facts only (no model labels, no admission verdicts).

normalized_digest.description: sha256-prefixed digest over the normalized interpretation (canonical cell identity, protocol version, admission verdict). Separate from raw_digest by construction.
